value.rationale: Frozen 0/1 arrow environments have deterministic local two-cycle traps, making global geometric refreshing a mathematically extreme yet natural homogenization test. The exact transport laws and global symmetric-vs-biased diffusivity monotonicity boundary answer a genuine all-rate question. In the asymmetric case an intermediate refresh rate creates strictly more fluctuation than complete refresh, a structural phase effect not captured by generic CLT existence or local Taylor information. No broader extension or optimal maximizing refresh value is claimed.
